bullets.text: Copilot Enhancements Roll Out - **Microsoft** introduces real-time text editing features for Windows Insiders with Copilot.
Microsoft Store Milestones - Over 250 million users enjoyed a more personalized experience in the **Microsoft Store** in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are rolling out in **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.7523.
E-book on Security Solutions - **Microsoft** releases an e-book discussing the limitations of point solutions in cybersecurity.
